title: 第二十五章 修炼小成第二十六章 突破二次扣关
slug: 从白猿拳破限开始成就人间武圣
content_zh:
安抚好苏鸿后，苏羽和大伯母来到外屋。
空气中弥漫着压抑的沉默。
苏羽看着大伯母红肿的双眼，轻声道：“大伯母，大哥的伤……平日里可还撑得住？”
说到这，大伯母眼泪瞬间决堤，捂着嘴呜咽：“他哪撑得住啊！每晚疼得把被角都咬烂了，硬是一声不吭，就怕吵着我。”
苏羽无奈的叹了口气，“可找大夫看过？能否上些药止痛也好。”
大伯母摇摇头，“他……他不让。说是腿已经废了，再花钱也是浪费……”
听罢，苏羽直接从怀里掏出六两银子，塞到大伯母手中。
“小羽，这使不得，使不得，太多了……”
“大伯母，这是我欠大哥的，给他用药治疗着，能舒服些也好。”
……
离开苏鸿家，苏羽回了趟家，嘱咐了丫儿几句后，就直接返回了城里武馆。
如今之计，他必须尽快突破增强实力！
武者，一定要成为武者！
把武馆接下来的束脩费十两交上，又缴了四两的汤药费，苏羽身上再次只剩下五两银子应急。
【熟练度+2】
【熟练度+2】
……
时光荏苒，很快过了一个月时间。
这个月时间，苏羽心无旁骛，一心练白猿六变，钱家捕鱼队的出船没有参加，鱼骨功的修炼也放到了一旁。
偶尔身体疲累，走不了桩，就练习一下金钱掷。

在他如此专注勤练下，白猿六变的进度也终于来到了一半多。
【武学】：白猿六变（熟练5891200）
“不用一个月，自己就有机会突破到小成了。按照经验，小成经验对照的就是二次扣关！”
查看完白猿六变熟练度，苏羽又打开金钱掷查看。
【武学】：金钱掷（小成12500）
“哎，无心插柳柳成荫。这金钱掷偶尔解压练练，没想到先一步到了小成境界。虽然这学武的熟练度比起白猿六变少了不少，但是时间投入也少的多。”
苏羽从怀中掏出一块鹅卵石大小的石头，手腕一抖，朝着远处的铁木桩随手掷出。
“咻——噗！”
石块在空中一闪而过，精准命中十多丈远处的木桩，发出砰的一声闷响。
“这力道和准度，已经可以用于实战了！”苏羽思索着，如何把金钱掷转化为实力，用于提升自己。
“进山林之中猎杀飞禽和小兽完全没任何压力，能够挣不少钱，提升一下生活水平。可惜我的时间不够，和撒网技艺一样，如今自己若是拿出太多时间去挣银子，就会耽误练武时间。”
“还是练武太耗费银子了，我这汤药还只是一周三副，听说内院的师兄们基本一天一副。甚至有的武馆用的还是更贵的汤药，不是这壮骨汤！”
“得想办法弄个稳定生财的路子，或者继续提升赚钱能力，就不用像现在这样到处捉襟见肘了！”
又过了几日，月初考核，如期而至。
演武场上气氛凝重。
这次秦师和大师兄齐临枫都未露面，只有林婉竹、秦雨等内院弟子主持大局。
看样子之前大师兄齐临枫的伤势还没有好转，没有出现也是在意料之中。
不过秦师没有出现，倒是少见。
平日里秦师对外院学徒就不管不顾，只在每月月初考核出现一次，如今连考核都不出现了，许多人恐怕从拜师到淘汰，都只能见秦师一两面。
“今日月初例行考核，念到名字的出列考核。”
content_en:
After comforting Su Hong, Su Yu and his aunt came to the outer room.
An oppressive silence hung in the air.
Su Yu looked at the eldest aunt's red and swollen eyes and said softly: "Auntie, brother's injury...can he still hold up normally?"
Speaking of this, the eldest aunt's tears instantly burst into tears, covering her mouth and sobbing: "How can he hold on? It hurts so much that he chews up the corners of his quilt every night. He just keeps silent for fear of disturbing me."
Su Yu sighed helplessly, "Can I see a doctor? Can I give him some medicine to relieve the pain?"
The eldest aunt shook her head, "He...he wouldn't let me. He said that the legs were already useless, and it would be a waste to spend any more money..."
After hearing this, Su Yu took out six taels of silver from his pocket and stuffed it into the hands of his eldest aunt.
"Xiaoyu, this can't be done, it can't be done, it's too much..."
"Auntie, I owe this to my eldest brother. It's good to treat him with medicine and make him feel better."
…
After leaving Su Hong's house, Su Yu went back home. After giving Ya'er a few instructions, he returned directly to the martial arts school in the city.
The current plan is that he must break through and increase his strength as soon as possible!
A warrior must become a warrior!
After paying the next ten taels of repair fees for the martial arts school and another four taels of soup and medicine, Su Yu once again only had five taels of silver left for emergencies.
[Proficiency +2]
[Proficiency +2]
…
Time flies, and a month has passed quickly.
During this month, Su Yu was focused on practicing the Six Transformations of the White Ape. He did not participate in the Qian family's fishing team's boat trip, and put aside the practice of Fish Bone Kung Fu.
Occasionally when you feel tired and can't walk the pile, you can practice money throwing.
With his dedicated and diligent practice, the progress of White Ape's Six Transformations has finally reached more than half.
[Martial Arts]: Six Transformations of White Ape (Proficiency 5891200)
"In less than a month, I will have the opportunity to break through to a small success. According to experience, the comparison of Xiao Cheng's experience is the second deduction!"
After checking the White Ape's Sixth Transformation proficiency, Su Yu opened the money throw to check.
[Martial Arts]: Money Throwing (Xiao Cheng 12500)
"Hey, it was unintentional. I occasionally decompressed and practiced this money, but I didn't expect to reach the realm of Xiaocheng first. Although the proficiency of this martial arts is much less than that of Bai Yuan Liu, the time investment is also much less."
Su Yu took out a pebble-sized stone from his arms, flicked his wrist, and threw it towards the iron wooden stake in the distance.
"Pfft!"
The stone flashed through the air and accurately hit the wooden pile more than ten feet away, making a muffled sound.
"This strength and accuracy can already be used in actual combat!" Su Yu thought about how to turn money into strength and use it to improve himself.
"There is no pressure at all to hunt birds and small animals in the mountains and forests. I can earn a lot of money and improve my living standard. Unfortunately, I don't have enough time. Just like the skill of casting nets, if I spend too much time to earn money now, it will delay my martial arts training time."
"Practicing martial arts is still too expensive. I only use three pairs of soups a week. I heard that the brothers in the inner courtyard basically use one pair a day. Some martial arts schools even use more expensive soups, not this bone-strengthening soup!"
"You have to find a way to make money stably, or continue to improve your earning power, so you don't have to be so stretched like now!"
A few days later, the assessment at the beginning of the month came as scheduled.
The atmosphere in the martial arts arena was solemn.
This time neither Master Qin nor Senior Brother Qi Linfeng showed up. Only Lin Wanzhu, Qin Yu and other inner courtyard disciples were in charge of the overall situation.
It seemed that senior brother Qi Linfeng's injury had not improved yet, so his absence was expected.
However, Master Qin did not appear, which was rare.
Normally, Master Qin ignores the apprentices from the outer courtyard and only appears once for the assessment at the beginning of each month. Now he doesn't even show up for the assessment. I am afraid that many people will only see Master Qin once or twice from apprenticeship to elimination.
"There will be a routine assessment at the beginning of today. Those whose names are read will be listed out for assessment."
